messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: mid-stream cutoffs still happening. Need single-owner list and short deadlines for resume token, keepalive, client retries, and alerts. Who takes what?

joel: I'll own resume-token server work. Plan: attach `resume_token` on final content frame, TTL 60s, and add log fields `resume_token=%s age_ms=%d`. Spike + unit tests by Wed.

ria: I'll own client retry strategy and rollout. Proposal: try resume if token present within TTL, jitter backoff base 200ms, max 3 attempts. Feature-flagged canary 5%->25%->100%. PR by Thu.

oncall-sre: I'll add alerts and update runbook. Metrics to add: `stream_partial_count`, `stream_last_gap_ms`, `resume_attempts_total`, `resume_success_total`. Pager if partial_rate >0.2% for 10m or resume_fail_rate >8% for 15m. Runbook update in 48h.

maria: Good. Canaries: staging 48h -> us-west-2 72h. Acceptance: partial_response_rate <0.03% and resume_success >=98% for 48h before closing the epic.

joel: Implementation note: don't GC resume token until TTL expires and avoid closing connection until final ack sent. Will include sampled debug payload on resume fail.

ria: I'll add client header `X-Client-Stream-Stage` and correlation `X-Trace-Stream` for debugging. Tests will simulate metadata-only final frames.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-8810: "stream-resume-triage-epic". Assignees: joel, ria, oncall-sre.

maria: I'll schedule daily 10m syncs for the next 5 workdays and post PR/dashboard links here. Ping if blocked. :white_check_mark:
